capabilities: hide right-sidebar tabs and show them again
close tabs that other plugins reopen at startup
run via commands in eight languages
extras: README notes hidden tabs are fully closed, so their scroll position and state reset when shown again; only the right sidebar is handled; no network use.
problem: Obsidian gives no built-in way to hide unwanted right-sidebar tabs or control their order, and plugins can reopen their own tabs on startup.
summary: Settings panel and commands to hide or reorder tabs in the right sidebar, applying changes immediately and keeping them across restarts.
